summary: Completed full backend (pytest) and frontend (Playwright) testing for the Cortex Láser cost calculator. All 5 backend pytest cases passed (root health, materials list seeded with 9 items, materials CRUD, settings GET/PUT, quotes CRUD with sort & 404 on delete). All responses verified to NOT include MongoDB _id. Frontend: Cotizador form sections render, live summary recomputes in real time, saving a quote shows toast, the saved quote appears in /historial, /materiales lists seed materials, /configuracion loads, sidebar navigation works between all routes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); recommend migrating to lifespan handler.
POST /api/materials and /api/quotes return 200; consider 201 Created for REST correctness.
Quotes endpoint accepts client-computed totals (materialCost, total, etc.) without server-side validation; trustworthy only because there is no auth, but worth re-computing server-side later.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 9 default materials and global settings on startup (verified). One TEST_E2E_Quote was created via UI; can be removed via DELETE /api/quotes/{id} if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers all CRUD + _id exclusion + sort-desc. Public URL via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. data-testid attributes used: nav-cotizador/historial/materiales/configuracion, input-project-name, input-client-name, input-piece-width/height, input-quantity, input-cutting-time, input-engraving-time, select-material, btn-save-quote, btn-save-print, summary-total, summary-per-unit, row-*. Print page (/cotizacion/:id/imprimir) and Materiales create/edit/delete dialog were not directly exercised via UI but underlying APIs verified.
